scripts.setup: npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-core install && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-ingest install && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-api install
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:lod2 && npm run check:server
scripts.check:server: cd server && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && DATABASE_URL=${BAUWERK_TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgres://lod2:lod2@127.0.0.1:55433/bauwerk_test} npm test
scripts.check:lod2: npm --prefix lod2/lod2-core run typecheck && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-core run lint && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-core test && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-ingest run typecheck && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-ingest run lint && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-ingest test && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-api run typecheck && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-api run lint && npm --prefix lod2/lod2-api test
scripts.index: npm --prefix lod2/lod2-ingest run --silent lod2 -- index --state BE
scripts.ingest: npm --prefix lod2/lod2-ingest run --silent lod2 -- tiles --state BE --bbox-wgs84 13.375,52.481,13.392,52.492
scripts.status: npm --prefix lod2/lod2-ingest run --silent lod2 -- status --state BE
scripts.bootstrap: npm run db && npm run migrate && npm run index && npm run ingest
